critical_code_review_comments: Bypass guard dialog (AlertDialog in TaskManagementModule.jsx) — implementation is correct. All 3 options present: 'Batal (Buka Drawer)', 'Eksekusi Sekarang' (opens TaskDetailDrawer), 'Tandai Done Manual'. Cannot be tested via Playwright due to react-beautiful-dnd drag simulation limitations.
DailyReportModule: uses date picker instead of shadcn Calendar — uses browser native date input. This is acceptable and consistent with other modules.
MonthlyReportModule has key prop issue on the expanded row fragment (line 172: no key on React fragment with both row and expanded row). Minor potential React warning but not a functional bug.
Backend files are well within 300 lines (marketing_targets.py: 229 lines, marketing_reports.py: 293 lines) — good.
All endpoints properly use require_auth() for auth check.
All MongoDB queries use {'_id': 0} projection to exclude _id — good.
API uses serialize_doc() helper — ensures JSON serialization safety.
